text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos, I'm so sorry! Even though it's 
your birthday, I just couldn't make up my 
mind on a present...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine, totally fine~! I mean, 
it just shows how seriously you thought 
about it, right? Ehehe, I'm so happy~ Now 
you've got my hopes up~♡

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I wanted to find something that 
Vivlos-san would truly love, so I thought 
hard about it... Though I couldn't help 
feeling nervous about it...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
What are you worried about~?? Come on, 
tell me! I'll answer you completely 
seriously!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Well then... allow me to ask!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A lion, or a cruiser! Which would you 
prefer!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehhhhhh!? I want both of theeeem!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I knew it~! You did mention you wanted to 
keep a lion! As for the cruiser, it looks 
like I can get one from an acquaintance of 
my father's!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've heard that taking care of them 
and maintaining them is quite an ordeal... 
so I'm not sure what to do...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, true... Even if a lion showed up 
right now, I might not be able to make it 
happy... I don't even have a harbor for a 
cruiser~...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right now, something easy to wear would be 
great! Like accessories or something like 
that~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, they're fine with lions? That's so 
high-class~! I wanna be able to drop 
something like that so casually too~!!)
